description:
This is the config page for Popular pages reports.
To request modifications, use {{edit fully-protected}} on the talk page.
Please keep the following points in mind before editing this page:
* The 'Name' field should match the PROJECT parameter used in your project's banner template. A full list of valid project names can be found at https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=projects&pjsubprojects=true. You can also refer to Special:PageAssessments. If you don't see your project, it's probably because the WikiProject template isn't set up properly.
* The maximum limit for the report length is 1000 records.
* Projects with more than 1,000,000 pages (e.g. WikiProject Biography) cannot currently be processed by the bot.
* Please try to avoid changing the Report link for the sake of consistency across projects. Instead, it'd be helpful to redirect existing pages to this link.

When requesting a new project addition or changing one, make sure the project block looks like:
"Wikipedia:WikiProject A Song of Ice and Fire": {
	"Report": "Wikipedia:WikiProject A Song of Ice and Fire/Popular pages",
	"Limit": 1000,
	"Name": "A Song of Ice and Fire"
},

Wikipedia:WikiProject A Song of Ice and.Report: Wikipedia:WikiProject A Song of Ice and Fire/Popular pages
Wikipedia:WikiProject A Song of Ice and.Name: A Song of Ice and Fire
